_comment: Copy to <repo>/.claude/quality-gates.json for a Go repo whose go.mod is at the repo root. "go": {} runs crap-gate.py and mutation.py on the home Go profile alone (~/.claude/config/home.json toolchains languages.go: coverage with -coverpkg=./..., go test -failfast, gofmt -l and go vet as checks); a key added here replaces the profile's (e.g. "cwd": "<dir>" when go.mod lives in a subdirectory). The other keys and their meaning: ~/.claude/templates/quality-gates.json (the Python version).
